lines.text: Let's dig. Deeper rock means older rock.
About two hundred thirty million years ago, the first dinosaurs show up.
lines.caption: About 230 million years ago, the first dinosaurs show up.

lines.text: Dig deeper. About three hundred eighty-five million years ago, the first trees appear.
lines.caption: Dig deeper. About 385 million years ago, the first trees appear.

lines.text: Deeper still. About four hundred fifty million years ago: the oldest shark-like scales ever found.
lines.caption: Deeper still. About 450 million years ago: the oldest shark-like scales ever found.

lines.text: So sharks beat trees by about sixty-five million years.
lines.caption: So sharks beat trees by about 65 million years.

lines.text: And they beat the dinosaurs by over two hundred million.
lines.caption: And they beat the dinosaurs by over 200 million.
